plugins.name: close-epic-launcher
plugins.description: Closes the Epic Games Launcher when a game starts, so it doesn't run in the background while you play

plugins.name: discord-presence
plugins.description: Shows the game you're playing in your Discord status, with the time played so far

plugins.name: library-worth
plugins.description: Adds up what your library costs on the Epic Games Store, at full price and today ("heirloom worth")

plugins.name: notifications
plugins.description: A desktop notification when a game finishes installing or updating

plugins.name: power-plan
plugins.description: Switches Windows to the High performance power plan while a game runs, and back afterwards
